criterion_text: With Server Token `S` and two different Agent Tokens `A`/`B`, Web/CLI authenticate Server with `S` and each Agent with its own token; `S` does not grant direct Agent P2P access, `A` cannot authenticate to B or Server, and invalid/empty/late/repeated authentication or premature business frames fail closed without changing connection identity.

verifiers.summary: Server Token and per-Agent Tokens authenticate only their owning endpoint; invalid, empty, late, repeated and premature authentication fail closed

evidence.value: exact target SHA stack: Server accepted S and refused A; Agent A accepted A and refused S, B and empty; Agent B accepted B and refused A; S could not open either Agent; premature, repeated and late authentication each failed closed and granted no authority

crates/nession-agent/src/server/websocket.rs: client.auth is verified before any business frame; crates/nession-server/src/server/handler/server_auth_v1.rs and server_agent_register_v1.rs compare each endpoint's own token
